definitions.gloss: to become used to eating; to get accustomed to eating
definitions.explanation: to develop a taste for or comfort with eating a particular food through repeated experience

examples.japanese: {納豆|なっとう}は{食|た}べ{慣|な}れると{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Natto is delicious once you get used to eating it.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{食|しょく}べ{物|もの}に{食|た}べ{慣|な}れた。
examples.english: I've gotten used to eating Japanese food.

examples.japanese: {辛|から}いものは{食|た}べ{慣|な}れていないので{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I'm not used to eating spicy food, so I don't handle it well.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{食|た}べる (to eat) + {慣|な}れる (to become accustomed)

CONJUGATION:
- {食|た}べ{慣|な}れる (dictionary form)
- {食|た}べ{慣|な}れた (past)
- {食|た}べ{慣|な}れている (progressive - accustomed state)
- {食|た}べ{慣|な}れていない (not accustomed)

PATTERN:
~{慣|な}れる compound verbs (become used to ~):
- {聞|き}き{慣|な}れる - become used to hearing
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れる - become used to living
- {見慣|みな}れる - become used to seeing
- {使|つか}い{慣|な}れる - become used to using

RELATED:
- {慣|な}れる - to get used to
- {慣|な}れ{親|した}しむ - to become familiar with
